note: The products on the shelf from 15 Nov 2026. The owner selected each EAN directly in the Valio Aimo catalogue and confirmed its availability there; these exact entries are used, with no search for alternatives and no retail EAN substituted. This file names products for recognition, labels and display: it grants no purchasing authority (the signed rule set decides what may be ordered and is unchanged). The camera counts consumer units (count_unit); the catalogue sells in its sales unit; the two quantities are kept apart (backend/products.py).

selection.statement: EANs selected directly from the Valio Aimo catalogue; availability there confirmed by the owner

purchasing_authority: none: recognition and display only. Purchasing eligibility is the signed rule set (version 4: rye bread, natural yoghurt, lactose-free milk drink), unchanged. Shelf events stay observe-only; automatic cloud recognition grants no purchasing authority.

routing.note: A local detection whose score is at or below its product's kimi_at_or_below goes to the cloud model (Kimi) automatically in detection/repeat mode, once a local model trained for this set is running. This routing threshold is separate from the minimum score for showing a box (display_min_score). Values marked provisional are adjustable.
routing.conflict_note: Two local boxes of different products that overlap by at least this share of the smaller box are one object with conflicting classes: escalated, never counted twice.
routing.flavour_margin_note: provisional: a shake whose best flavour score is within this margin of another flavour's score is escalated even above its threshold
routing.scene_note: provisional: a cloud answer is reused only while the object's box and its crop stay the same (box IoU and mean absolute pixel difference of a small grey thumbnail)
routing.cloud_timeout_note: covers the vision model's two steps (38 s + 14 s at most)

profeel-shake.note: Three flavours in near-identical bottles. Only a readable flavour decides the product; an unreadable flavour stays 'PROfeel shake, flavour uncertain' and is never a guessed product.
